fieldNotes.step0: Confirmed Layton Bakery (Bldg 5) — the southern production building of the Kroger/Smith's Layton campus at 500 N Sugar St. Identified by the flour silos on its roof (z20 imagery) and its dedicated north + south angled dock bands, distinct from the solar-roofed Smith's DC to the north and the heavy-process dairy plant to the east. Supplied coords (41.065045,-111.984294) landed in the truck-circulation yard just off the bakery's north dock face; locked building center at 41.06435,-111.98370.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, swing/sliding gate, or guard booth across the campus access road where it meets Sugar Street. Street View (2022-11, pano CgSbthrtbapZsvp6GChSMA) down the west entrance drive shows an open, uncontrolled paved entrance into the parking/yard with only chain-link perimeter fencing flanking it. Open-access campus.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the property line. The only small freestanding structure inside the yard (~41.0653,-111.9846) is a yard-truck dispatch/maintenance office surrounded by yard tractors and employee cars, not an entrance checkpoint.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No truck gate exists, so no remote check-in either; false by rule.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large shared internal paved yard between the DC and the bakery's north dock face provides deep internal queueing/staging before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal yard and long approach from the Sugar St entrance easily holds 3+ trucks before reaching the bakery docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single shared campus entrance off Sugar St serves both in and out; no separate dedicated truck out-gate observed.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Open entrance apron ~2 lanes wide; estimated from imagery, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated equal to entry on the shared open drive; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open entrance apron and expansive internal paved yard leave ample unused width to channelize an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Bakery has two angled dock bands (north + south faces) with many trailers backed in; counted ~45 doors total across both faces (25-50 band). Door count partly obscured by backed-in trailers — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop activity: a large angled trailer drop lot south/southeast of the bakery and a fan-shaped trailer yard north of it (shared campus), holding well over 50 parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Bakery runs ship/receive from two physically separate dock banks on opposite (north and south) building faces.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the developed Layton/Salt Lake metro fabric — industrial corridor bordered immediately by residential subdivisions to the south and east; Urban.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Dense suburban metro setting; cellular coverage is good. False.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Bakery sits on a multi-building campus (Smith's DC, bakery Bldg 5, and dairy/process plant), so the broader property is a campus — flagged true.
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale/weigh pad identified at the bakery's docks or the campus entrance; left false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the bakery or the campus; false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~24 acres for the bakery building footprint plus its immediate dock aprons and adjacent drop lots; the full Kroger/Smith's campus is much larger. Approximate.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Traced to the Layton Bakery (Bldg 5) building footprint including its north and south dock faces; the building is grid-aligned (square to N-S/E-W) like the rest of the campus, only the drop-yard trailers are angled.
